jsQR is distributed locally for camera admission scanning, from https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR at commit 8e6a036beafa7053dd44b1b76ac578d22b1b3311. The Apache-2.0 license is included in jsQR.LICENSE. No ticket verification code is sent to an external QR service.

The local QR encoder is mpdf/qrcode v1.2.2 (https://github.com/mpdf/qrcode); original source, data and LGPL license are retained in mpdf-qrcode/. PHP 7.2+ supplies its native random_bytes dependency. Shared PDF Support supplies mPDF itself.
